name: Flat Out
description: The volume near its top: the six output valves clip, thick and compressed, under a preamp that is still nearly clean.

name: Mid Punch
description: The first channel with its middle lifted at 800 Hz and the volume past half way: the notes push through a loud band, the stack's punchy rock sound.

name: Pick Clank
description: Ultra high on and the treble up at a middling volume: the pick's attack and the strings' clank on top of the growl, for punk and metal.

name: Rock Growl
description: The volume past half way and the stack a little up at both ends: a played bass growls on the hard notes and stays round on the soft ones, the classic rock bass sound.

name: Round Fingers
description: The volume low, the bass up and the treble down: a warm, round sound for fingers that stays clean.

name: Scooped Growl
description: The first channel with its middle cut low and the bass and treble up, driven: a deep, wide growl under heavy guitars.

name: Ultra Low Deep
description: Ultra low on, the lows straight through and the rest some 8 dB down, with the treble low: deep and dark for slow lines and reggae.
